t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Earthy colours seem to be the best colours to pick, but when there's a multiplier then the non-earthy colours can be a good choice. But sometimes it can still be random.

vb_textbox.text: I found that the more "neon" colours along the lines of the the bright pink and blue etc seemed to be more reliable. Towards the end of the game though it seemed to switch and the more subtle colours seemed to end up with more mushrooms. It didn't seem to follow a pattern the whole way through though, so just go with your instinct and you'll soon pick up on any patterns that are happening.
